concepts.name: Paper & marker
concepts.description: A refined evolution of the current warm paper identity. An open hero pairs the main action with a real sample question; subject choices become a compact shelf below.
concepts.layout: Retain the slim left sidebar on the same paper background. Main area: spacious two-column hero, left contains title and actions, right a beautiful white reading-question preview. Below, five compact horizontal subject modules arranged in a single row. Deliberate typography and breathing space. Warm ivory #f4f0e7, white sheets, ink #24231f and golden yellow #efbf24. Round humanist headings, Public Sans-like readable body. Subtle hand-drawn yellow marker underline on one heading word and almost no ornament. First-visit homepage. Design should look like an exceptionally crafted real reading tool.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HOMEPAGE mockup for Oefenschrift, a free Dutch integration exam practice app for adults. Output a large landscape 3:2 image, at least 1800px wide if possible. Show the website itself edge to edge, frontal and flat, without device frames, surrounding desk, perspective, watermark or title outside the app. Use the attached existing homepage only as a REFERENCE for product features, not an edit target. Reinvent the appearance according to the design direction. This is a visual concept with Dutch UI copy. Keep the wordmark 'Oefenschrift', A2 and B1 level choices, Lezen, Luisteren, Schrijven, Spreken, KNM, Proefexamen, Voortgang, compact NL / EN choice and theme control. No B2, accounts, pricing, official approval, exam pass predictions, fabricated testimonials, XP or streaks. Dutch body text must be spacious and readable. Prefer Public Sans-like humanist body, clear sans headings. The first-visit heading is 'Oefen voor je inburgeringsexamen'; supporting line 'Gratis oefenen. Geen account nodig.'; primary 'Begin met Lezen A2'; secondary 'Doe de niveaucheck'. Reading preview, when shown, must use exact source excerpt 'Morgen zijn wij gesloten. Vanaf donderdag bent u weer welkom.' and question 'Wanneer kan mevrouw Bakker haar fiets ophalen?' with A 'Morgen', B 'Vanaf donderdag', C 'Alleen vandaag'. A homepage sample is an excerpt, not a full exam item. Show either an unanswered sample or show B selected with subtle evidence marker. Five subject descriptions: Lezen 'Berichten en teksten'; Luisteren 'Gesprekken en berichten'; Schrijven 'Schrijf een bericht'; Spreken 'Vertel het in het Nederlands'; KNM 'Leven in Nederland'. No invented counts. Small footer 'Onafhankelijke oefenopgaven'. The design must feel cohesive at a real product scale, with carefully aligned spacing, excellent visual hierarchy and a distinctive visual idea.

concepts.name: Delft blue
concepts.description: Cobalt accents and a simple illustrated streetscape give the app a distinct Dutch identity. A broad hero leads into five clear subject rows.
concepts.layout: Slim left sidebar; generous asymmetric main page. Deep cobalt #244ce0 on porcelain white #fafbf8, pale blue #e8efff and a tiny acid yellow accent. Bold rounded sans headings. Hero text left, refined flat cobalt illustration of a Dutch bicycle beside canal houses at right, geometrically drawn with empty space, adult editorial style. Under hero arrange the five subjects as clean horizontal rows with a small meaningful line icon, one-line description, and arrow; two narrow columns for the rows with balanced space. Incorporate a small 'Probeer een vraag' preview below. Beautiful restrained Dutch graphic design, not travel marketing.

concepts.name: Warm notebook
concepts.description: A warm clay accent, notebook tabs and softly tinted paper make the home page feel like a place to study. The sample exercise becomes the central feature.
concepts.layout: Left navigation in warm paper, dark clay #974631 primary actions, peach #f4d8c6 section tabs, off-white #fffaf2 surfaces and dark brown ink. No serif; rounded confident sans headings, neutral readable sans body. Small hero title with restrained action; beneath it a large open-notebook composition made as actual flat UI, not photorealistic desk: left page shows five subject links in a tidy list, right page offers real reading sample. A few tab-like accents align with the subjects. No faux handwriting for study text. Minimal tactile line detail, broad margins, crafted warm grown-up stationery feel.

concepts.name: Graphic yellow
concepts.description: A strong typographic home page uses yellow blocks and numbered subject rows. This direction explores a compact top navigation in place of the sidebar.
concepts.layout: This is the deliberate layout departure: compact top navigation with Oefenschrift wordmark left, five subjects center, A2 B1 and NL EN right. Main centered 1160px canvas. Oversized crisp geometric sans heading, strong black ink #181818, bright flat yellow #f3cf2b, white #fffefb. Hero left is large type and one black action with yellow text; right is a yellow rectangle holding a small real sample question with clean black-outlined choices. Below hero, five numbered subject rows in a well-spaced two-column grid with hairline separators. Small 6px corners and clear visible button outlines. Swiss graphic poster sensibility adapted to an actual useful educational website, no ornamental blobs.

concepts.name: Quiet green
concepts.description: Forest green, warm white and generous spacing reduce visual strain. A clear continuation card gives returning learners a useful starting point.
concepts.layout: Slim left navigation, warm white #f8faf5 main canvas, forest green #265b45 and pale sage #e3ecdc. Rounded sans headings and generous reading text. Returning-learner homepage. Main heading 'Verder oefenen' with small supporting sentence 'Ga verder waar je was gebleven.' Large primary continuation module 'Lezen · Oefenset 1' with small 'Vraag 2 van 8' and 'Verdergaan' button, an understated progress line and small book illustration to the right. Beneath it five subject modules with beautifully proportioned broad icons and 1-line descriptions. Small 'Probeer een vraag' panel can be lower. Quiet adult friendly botanical sensibility but use only a tiny plant sprig illustration, no garden game, points, streaks, scores, invented social features.

concepts.name: Plum studio
concepts.description: Plum and lavender support broad rounded components without making the app childish. Speaking and writing get a more welcoming visual presence.
concepts.layout: Keep narrow left sidebar in white matching the page background, muted plum #603d73 primary buttons, pale lavender #eee9f3, peach #f6dfcb, ink #302535. Rounded sans headings with substantial weight, extremely clear humanist body. Hero in a wide very pale lavender panel with rounded 24px corners, copy left and a sophisticated abstract illustration of overlapping speech bubbles and a pencil at right. Below, asymmetrical subject grid: Reading and Listening wide first row; Writing, Speaking, KNM equal second row. Cards are white with thin plum-tinted border, icon occupies separate calm header area. Include a slim sample-question strip below. Mature creative studio sensibility, no mascot, gradients or thick shadows.

concepts.name: Night desk
concepts.description: Charcoal surfaces and amber accents carry the paper identity into a focused evening interface. A compact shelf of subjects keeps the home page useful.
concepts.layout: Dark UI screenshot with neutral charcoal #202120 page, lifted sheet #2b2d29, warm white #f0f0e6 text, gray secondary text with high contrast and amber #edc343 primary actions. No blue cast. Left sidebar same as ground, fine divider. Top hero compact left aligned with strong sans title, a small editorial amber desk lamp illustration on right shining a FLAT geometric warm patch, no realistic glow gradients. Below hero an airy two-column composition: five subject rows in left 55%, a generous real sample question card on right 45%. Compact outlined audio-player preview lower down. Refined night study tool, typography crisp and spacious, no neon or sci-fi dashboard.

concepts.name: Colour workshop
concepts.description: Distinct subject colours and small geometric illustrations make the catalogue easier to scan. Larger, varied tiles give the home page more energy.
concepts.layout: Keep left sidebar, off-white #fbf9f2 ground, coral #cf563f primary actions, cobalt #3158c5 and marigold #edbd38 accents. Main title large round sans. Main subject area is an editorial asymmetric tile grid: Reading is a tall pale-yellow tile with stylized folded letter, Listening wide pale-blue tile with neat headphones, Writing pale-pink pencil tile, Speaking pale-lilac dialogue tile, KNM pale-sage house tile. Each label always printed with its icon, color is not sole identifier. Plenty of whitespace inside tiles, readable dark text, playful geometric flat illustrations with grown-up art direction, no mascot, badges or gamified points. Place hero CTA before tile grid. Small real sample question band below.
